observations.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards claimed a retaliatory attack on a US early-warning radar in Bahrain after an alleged strike on a telecommunications tower in Sirik, Iran. Reuters reported no immediate US or Bahraini confirmation. Damage, weapon, and event time unverified; this is a newly published claim, not a confirmed strike.
observations.title: IRGC claims strike against US early-warning radar in Bahrain

observations.summary: Reuters reports Taiwanese security officials described unannounced early-November western Pacific drills involving more than 100 Chinese naval and coast guard vessels at peak, with roughly 70 remaining by Friday. Exercise was earlier than publication, not a new deployment this hour. Beijing characterized carrier activity as routine; no verified blockade or imminent attack.
observations.title: Taiwan officials disclose unusually large unannounced Chinese naval drills
